skill.displayName: Shopee-选品决策专家 | 青虎AI

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Shopee market-analysis workflow that uses Qinghu APIs, paid calls, and report exports in ways that fit its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill calls a specific Qinghu HTTP API and may read QINGHU_TOKEN or QHKIT_TOKEN; this is disclosed and coherent for authenticated API access, with instructions to obtain user approval before paid tool calls.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a markdown skill file with no executable scripts, installers, package hooks, or background setup instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation wording is broad in places, but the surrounding text repeatedly scopes use to Shopee major project analysis and warns against using it for routine lightweight product picking.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill directs default spreadsheet export for larger result sets and use of cached local files; this is report-aligned and disclosed, but users should be aware that business analysis data may persist locally.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes a major Shopee product-selection report using market, category, shop, item, price, and keyword data; it does not instruct listing changes, account mutations, scraping, or unrelated data access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you intend the agent to use a Qinghu API key, make user-approved paid Qinghu data calls, and create spreadsheet/report attachments for Shopee analysis. In shared or sensitive environments, prefer a dedicated low-privilege Qinghu token and review or delete exported files after use.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] expected: Accepted only as a caution: the token source is explicitly documented and necessary for the Qinghu API, but environment-variable tokens should be scoped carefully in shared runtimes.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded: the description includes broad phrases, but the artifact anchors the skill to Shopee selection decisions, major project reports, and Qinghu data workflows.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded: the trigger examples are not exhaustive boundary rules, but they are Shopee-specific and the artifact includes a clear warning not to use this heavy workflow for routine picking.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted as a user-awareness note rather than a verdict driver: default export is explicitly stated in the data-delivery section and fits the report purpose, though retention and deletion behavior are not specified.
